title: DecisionReceiptVerifyRequest
description: A signed readiness receipt plus the request and action hashes expected by the enforcing caller.

expected_request_hash.description: SHA-256 JCS hash computed from the enforcing caller's own copy of the complete request; do not copy it blindly from the receipt response.

expected_action_hash.description: SHA-256 JCS hash computed from the enforcing caller's own actor, requested_action, target, and risk_tier object.
